world.title: In Bizarre AI Video, Trump Plays With Tiger That Killed UK Man
world.summary: US President Donald Trump shared an AI-generated video depicting him wrestling and playing with a tiger, shortly after the animal killed a man at a UK zoo. The video sparked backlash on social media, with users labeling Trump as "mentally unwell" and "disrespectful." Critics expressed concern over the timing and nature of the content shared by the former president.

world.title: China’s AI research is booming: what it’s like to be on the front line
world.summary: China is leading in AI talent development, training more individuals than any other nation. Analysts and researchers highlight the dynamic working environment in China, contrasting it with the United States. As graduates like Lu Yi consider their futures, the decision to pursue advanced studies abroad remains significant, reflecting the competitive landscape of AI research and opportunities available domestically.

world.title: Saudi-led coalition intercepts Houthi missile launched towards Riyadh
world.summary: The Saudi-led coalition intercepted and destroyed a Houthi ballistic missile aimed at Riyadh, according to the Saudi civil defense authority. Alerts were issued via the national early warning platform, indicating that the danger had passed. The Houthi group claimed responsibility for the missile launch, stating it had conducted further attacks on Saudi Arabia.

business.title: College Student Works As Blinkit Delivery Executive, Reveals His First Day Earnings
business.summary: LLB student Kaval Desai shared his experience working as a delivery executive for Blinkit, earning Rs 508 in six hours, including a bonus. He started the job on October 13 to supplement his income. Desai's positive feedback has garnered attention on social media, highlighting the potential for students to earn through delivery services while managing their studies.

business.title: Largest-ever FDI in India’s financial sector: Cabinet approves sale of IDBI Bank to Fairfax for ₹52,878 crore
business.summary: The Union Cabinet approved Fairfax's acquisition of a 60.72% stake in IDBI Bank for ₹52,878 crore, marking the largest foreign direct investment in India's financial sector. This strategic restructuring aims to enhance the bank's operations and financial stability. Following the sale, the government's stake in IDBI Bank will reduce significantly, reflecting a shift in ownership dynamics.

business.title: SEBI Extends Relaxation on IPO Fresh Issue Size Changes Until March 2027
business.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has extended a relaxation allowing companies to adjust their IPO fresh issue size by up to 50% without needing to file new draft offer documents. This extension is valid until March 31, 2027, and is subject to specific conditions. The measure aims to facilitate smoother IPO processes for companies.

technology.title: Shams Mulani: 'The door has not opened yet, but I am a patient guy'
technology.summary: Shams Mulani, a consistent left-arm spinner from Mumbai, has not yet received an India call-up despite his strong domestic performance over the past five years. He made his Duleep Trophy debut four years ago and has participated in the Irani Cup and India A matches. Mulani remains patient and committed to continuing his efforts in pursuit of national selection.

technology.title: Rockstar Officially Confirms Next GTA Game Won’t Take Another 8 Years
technology.summary: Rockstar Games has confirmed that the development of its next major game after Grand Theft Auto 6 (GTA 6) will not take another eight years. The studio attributes this shorter timeline to advancements in technology, enhanced development tools, and the expertise of its experienced team. This announcement comes ahead of the anticipated launch of GTA 6.

technology.title: Rockstar Promises Fans Won't Have to Wait Another 8 Years for Its Next Game
technology.summary: Rockstar Games has assured fans that its next game will not take eight years to release, unlike Grand Theft Auto VI. In an interview with Bloomberg's Jason Schreier, top executives indicated that the development of GTA VI has established a strong foundation for future projects. This announcement aims to alleviate concerns about lengthy waiting periods for upcoming titles.

sports.title: Prime Minister Narendra Modi To Honour India's Asian Games Stars In Delhi On October 15
sports.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will honor the Indian athletes who participated in the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games during an event in New Delhi on October 15. The interaction is scheduled for 4:30 PM at Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium. This meeting aims to recognize the achievements of the Indian contingent in the recently concluded multi-sport event.

sports.title: Not Parthiv Patel, 24-Test Veteran To Be Next Full-Time Chief Selector: Report
sports.summary: Parthiv Patel has chosen not to apply for the West Zone vacancy on the BCCI senior men's selection committee, which closed on Wednesday. This decision allows Pragyan Ojha to remain as chairman. Patel, a former India wicketkeeper with 24 Test matches, was previously considered a frontrunner to replace Ajit Agarkar in this role.

sports.title: Iyer moves to fourth in T20I batting rankings
sports.summary: India's T20I captain Shreyas Iyer has ascended to fourth place in the T20I batting rankings. Meanwhile, South Africa's Aiden Markram has entered the top ten of the Test batting charts, and Australia's Josh Hazlewood has climbed to seventh in the Test bowling rankings. These updates reflect the latest changes in international cricket standings as of October 14, 2026.

health.title: Northwestern scientists studying proteins linked to Alzheimer's found a single spot that helps harmful tau clumps spread; blocking that hotspot with a chemical tag stopped the clumps from growing in l
health.summary: Northwestern scientists identified a specific hydrophobic hotspot in tau proteins that facilitates the formation of harmful clumps associated with Alzheimer's disease. This hotspot, located deep within the brain, interacts with water molecules, promoting clump growth. By blocking this hotspot with a chemical tag, researchers successfully halted the expansion of these detrimental tau clumps, offering potential therapeutic insights.

health.title: Ectopic tooth found in upper eye socket thought to be world first
health.summary: Doctors at Aravind Eye Hospital in Madurai, India, removed a mature canine tooth from the eye socket of a 16-year-old boy, marking a case of ectopic tooth believed to be the first of its kind. The patient reported a painless swelling before the discovery. This unusual occurrence highlights the complexities of dental and ocular health.

health.title: Men can also get breast cancer: Doctors share symptoms to look out for
health.summary: Men can develop breast cancer, though it is less common than in women. Symptoms include lumps near the nipple, which may be mistaken for minor injuries. Risk factors include BRCA gene mutations. Early diagnosis is crucial for effective treatment. Awareness of these symptoms and risk factors can lead to timely medical intervention, improving outcomes for affected men.

science.title: Why do big dogs live shorter lives? Study points to faster DNA ageing
science.summary: A recent study explores why larger dog breeds, like Great Danes, have shorter lifespans compared to smaller breeds, such as Chihuahuas. Contrary to the general trend in mammals where larger species tend to live longer, this research suggests that the accelerated aging of DNA in larger dogs may contribute to their reduced lifespan within the same species.

science.title: NASA's latest satellite imagery reveals Australia's giant spider; the striking landscape created by an ancient impact is a huge crater
science.summary: NASA's recent satellite imagery has unveiled the Spider Crater in Western Australia, a geological feature formed by an ancient meteorite impact estimated to be 600–900 million years old. While it appears as a rugged terrain from the ground, the crater's distinct shape is more visible from space, highlighting its significance in understanding Earth's geological history.

science.title: Japan's MMX Mission 2026: Is Mars's largest moon, "Phobos" hiding a secret? Know launch date, time and how to watch live
science.summary: Japan's MMX mission is set to launch on October 20, 2026, to explore Phobos, Mars's largest moon. The mission aims to collect surface samples and return them to Earth, potentially uncovering secrets about the moon's composition and history. Live-stream details for the launch will be provided as the date approaches, allowing global audiences to watch the event.

entertainment.title: 'Drishyam 3’ director Abhishek Pathak rules out ‘Drishyam 4’, says Ajay Devgn, Shriya Saran and Tabu starrer thriller has reached a ‘beautiful ending’: ‘Let’s not spoil it’
entertainment.summary: Director Abhishek Pathak has confirmed that there will be no fourth installment in the 'Drishyam' franchise, stating that 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' provides a satisfying end to Vijay Salgaonkar’s story. He emphasized the importance of not spoiling the narrative's resolution, which stars Ajay Devgn, Shriya Saran, and Tabu, marking a definitive conclusion to the thriller series.

entertainment.title: Arjun Bijlani apologises, backs wife amid backlash over T-shirt with Islam reference
entertainment.summary: Actor Arjun Bijlani addressed backlash over his wife Neha Swami Bijlani wearing a T-shirt with sacred Islamic names. He clarified that she was unaware of the shirt's meaning and expressed regret for any unintended offense caused. Bijlani condemned the abuse and threats directed at her, emphasizing the need for understanding and respect in such situations.

entertainment.title: Mrunal Thakur on 'Pooja Meri Jaan': A woman's 'no' doesn't mean 'try harder'
entertainment.summary: Mrunal Thakur approached the makers of "Pooja Meri Jaan" after learning its story focused on consent and a woman's right to say no. She emphasized that the film challenges the notion that a woman's "no" can be disregarded. Thakur noted that the film has initiated important conversations about consent and has positively influenced viewers' perspectives on the topic.
